output_json.diff_review: The non-POV diff modifies only two files. PropertyClass.java: fromString() now obtains the thread context classloader (falling back to PropertyClass's own loader) and calls Class.forName(v, false, loader), preventing static-initializer execution — the exact sink the POV exploited — while still returning the correct Class token needed by asString()/legitimate usage. PropertyTest.java: adds a self-contained regression test (tesPropertyClassFromStringDoesNotInitialize) with a StaticInitCanary helper asserting fromString resolves the class name but does not run its static initializer. This is a minimal, targeted vulnerability fix that preserves functionality; no vulnerable functionality is removed without justification (an allowlist was reasonably rejected since the property holds arbitrary user class names), no broad unrelated behavior is added, and the POV is untouched.
output_json.pov_result: Reran `bash .security-pipeline/pov/run_pov.sh` via the Docker wrapper: output "NOT VULNERABLE: no attacker code executed." with exit code 1. This matches the orchestrator's pov_after_patch (exit 1) and contrasts with pov_before_patch (exit 0, "VULNERABLE"). The gadget's static initializer no longer executes, confirming the RCE sink is closed.
output_json.regression_result: Reran `mvn -B -pl ff4j-core -am test -Dtest=PropertyTest -DfailIfNoTests=false` via the Docker wrapper: Tests run: 33, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0, BUILD SUCCESS. This includes the new regression test and the existing PropertyClass tests (tesInitPropertyClass, tesInitPropertyClass2), confirming legitimate class-resolution behavior is preserved.
output_json.summary: The patch fixes CWE-094 in PropertyClass.fromString() by replacing the single-arg Class.forName(v) — which loads AND initializes an attacker-controlled class (running its static initializer = RCE) — with Class.forName(v, false, loader), resolving the class token without initialization. The POV no longer reproduces (exit 1, "NOT VULNERABLE") and the PropertyTest suite passes (33/33), so the fix is accepted.
